env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. PREREQUISITE (provisioned host): the locally-built `ds-sop:1.0.0` image is already present -- it is LOCAL-BUILD-ONLY (no registry to pull; ~50 GB, built + smoke-tested per `references/services/sop/build-ds-sop.md`) -- and the SOP models (NGC nv-metropolis-dev/vss-industrial/sop-data:1.0, ~14.7 GB) plus the test video (NGC nvidia/tao/sop-server-fan-installation-data:1.0-260213) are staged. This single eval composes, validates, deploys, and runtime-verifies the SOP compliance-monitoring delta off the `alerts` (2d_vlm) Foundation -- `alerts` is the only current developer profile that ships `vss-va-mcp` (the report layer mounts the get_sop_* patch onto it) and it also owns Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, VIOS, and a VLM-perception slot. The get_sop_* patch is downloaded at build time from NVIDIA's public sop-monitoring-blueprints repo (pin 0dd472f) and staged BUILD-LOCAL under `_builds/sop-1/` -- nothing is vendored or written under `deploy/docker/`. Flow: DS-SOP step detection -> Kafka -> ELK, plus the skill-driven SOP compliance report (vss-va-mcp + the adapted get_sop_* patch, rendered by vss-generate-video-report Mode C) -- no RT-VLM, no runtime VSS agent/UI, no LLM-NIM report path. Use `_builds/sop-1/` only as a filesystem label; `deploy/docker/` remains authoritative and unmodified.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to compose, validate, and deploy an SOP compliance-monitoring application with SOP compliance reports under `_builds/sop-1/`: select the closest current Foundation and the smallest delta; download and adapt the get_sop_* patch build-local; stage the SOP JSON Logstash pipeline as a build-local overlay; run the Compose validation; then deploy the validated `resolved.yml` end-to-end (`ds-sop:1.0.0` is already built), feed DS-SOP the staged video DIRECTLY (on-demand `POST http://localhost:8300/v1/chat/completions`, max_length_sec=10), and verify SOP detection in Elasticsearch plus the skill-driven Mode C compliance report. Leave the stack running.
checks: Selects the `alerts` (2d_vlm) Foundation as the smallest delta (the only current developer profile shipping `vss-va-mcp`, and it already owns ELK, Kafka, Redis, VIOS, and a VLM-perception slot), then ADDS `ds-sop` + `sop-kibana-init` and REMOVES `rtvi-vlm` (DS-SOP takes the perception slot), `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `alert-bridge`, the alerts analytics/perception extras, and the LLM-NIM report key.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `ds-sop,sop-kibana-init,vss-va-mcp,nvstreamer-alerts,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,vss-haproxy-ingress,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms,phoenix` -- excluding `rtvi-vlm`, `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `alert-bridge`, and every LLM-NIM key, with no `sop-1`, aggregate, or other invented profile key.

The get_sop_* patch is DOWNLOADED at build time from NVIDIA's public sop-monitoring-blueprints repo (pin 0dd472f), adapted, and staged BUILD-LOCAL under `${SOP_STAGE_DIR}` = `_builds/sop-1/sop-report/` (the adapted `tools.py` = image tools.py + the four get_sop_* registrations, plus sibling `sop_tools.py`, under `video_analytics/`; the adapted VA-MCP config under `configs/`) -- not vendored, never written under `deploy/docker/`; the SOP JSON Logstash pipeline (`sop-vlm-captions-json-logstash.conf`) is staged as its OWN pipeline.id in a build-local overlay, NOT merged into the mdx-lvs protobuf pipeline.

`_builds/sop-1/` holds `override.env` (`FOUNDATION=alerts` + the DS-SOP/report knobs: `ENABLE_MESSAGING=1`, `DEFAULT_TOPIC=mdx-vlm-captions`, `SOP_MESSAGING_SCHEMA=JSON`, `ENABLE_RTSP_OUTPUT=true`, `RTSP_PORT=8554`, `SOP_STAGE_DIR`, `VSS_VA_MCP_CONFIG_FILE`) and `patches/{ds-sop.yml, vss-va-mcp.yml, logstash.yml}`, where `vss-va-mcp.yml` mounts the three get_sop_* binds -- `tools.py`, `sop_tools.py`, and the VA-MCP config at `${VSS_VA_MCP_CONFIG_FILE}` -- all sourced from `${SOP_STAGE_DIR}`, and `logstash.yml` repoints logstash's config + pipelines volume sources to the build-local overlay.

`docker compose -f _builds/sop-1/resolved.yml config --quiet`, `--services`, and `--images` succeed (every selected profile key resolves, required peers ELK/Kafka/VIOS resolve, excluded services do not, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, no real `${...}`/`<HOST_IP>` remains unresolved), and no file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified.

Deployment brings the stack up from the validated `_builds/sop-1/resolved.yml` (`docker compose ... up -d`) -- not a copied Compose project, an invented Compose profile, or a re-read of the Foundation env files; all long-running services are running/healthy, the one-shot inits (elasticsearch-init, kafka-topic-init, sop-kibana-init, VIOS helpers) exit 0, and no excluded RT-VLM/vss-agent/vss-ui/alert-bridge/LLM-NIM service is running.

ds-sop API readiness succeeds (`curl -sf http://localhost:8300/v1/ready` -> 200 and `/v1/models` contains `ds_sop_model`); Elasticsearch cluster health is green or yellow; Kafka topic `mdx-vlm-captions` exists; and logstash loaded the SOP JSON pipeline.id from the build-local overlay (no protobuf `ParseError` on this topic).

vss-va-mcp is Up (mcp serve on :9901) with the three adapted get_sop_* bind mounts present (`docker inspect` shows `tools.py`, `sop_tools.py`, and the VA-MCP config at `${VSS_VA_MCP_CONFIG_FILE}`, all from `${SOP_STAGE_DIR}`); `docker exec vss-va-mcp .../python3 -c "import <pkg>.video_analytics.sop_tools"` exits 0 (<pkg> resolved from the image -- `vss_agents` on develop); and MCP tools/list on :9901 (initialize -> tools/list) includes video_analytics__get_sop_status, __get_sop_report, __get_sop_as_incidents, and __get_sop_as_incident.

After feeding the staged video on-demand, `curl -sf 'http://localhost:9200/mdx-vlm-captions-*/_count'` returns `.count > 0`; sampled docs carry FLAT fields (chunk_idx, response, sensor_id, cv_boundary_score, pipeline_chunk_end_timestamp, req_id, checker_result) -- NOT protobuf-nested; doc `_id` equals req_id (idempotent upsert) and `@timestamp` derives from the wall-clock pipeline_chunk_end_timestamp (docs land on the real date, not 1970).

Detection is real: the `response` field shows REAL SOP steps in sequence (e.g. '(1) installing the first fan...' -> power supplies -> cover), NOT every doc being '(10) ... not belong', and cv_boundary_score across docs is a healthy mix (at least some >= 0.5, not all approximately 0).

DS-SOP -> VIOS wiring is verified: `POST /vst/api/v1/sensor/add` returns a sensorId and a `camera_streaming` event is published to Redis `vst.event` (resolved config sets `ENABLE_RTSP_OUTPUT=true`/`RTSP_PORT=8554`). The live annotated-stream `ffprobe rtsp://localhost:8554/ds-out/<stream-name>` and `record/start` are NOT asserted -- the per-request `:8554` output needs a live/looping source and recording needs a recorder microservice this profile does not ship; both are out of scope for this delta.

`video_analytics__get_sop_report` for the tested sensor returns report_summary / sop_violations / actions_observed / formatted_report (NOT an error), with REAL numbered SOP steps consistent with the mdx-vlm-captions-* docs (missing steps correctly flagged, not fabricated).

Running vss-generate-video-report Mode C for that sensor and range returns skill-rendered markdown titled '# SOP Compliance Report' that fills `references/report-templates/sop-compliance-report.md` with the real get_sop_report data (message count, compliance status, missing / mis-ordered step tables, actions observed) -- with no report service, VSS agent, web UI, POST /generate, or LLM NIM / NVIDIA_API_KEY.
